title: Sections of the constant sheaf of rings are locally constant
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $T_{\Et}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], $\Lambda$ a commutative ring and $\Lambda_T$ the constant sheaf of rings with value $\Lambda$ on $T_{\Et}$, i.e. the sheafification in sheaves of rings [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the constant presheaf of rings $W\mapsto\Lambda$ (all restriction maps $\mathrm{id}_\Lambda$) [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]; write $\iota_W:\Lambda\to\Lambda_T(W)$ for the components of the canonical morphism from the constant presheaf to its sheafification (ring homomorphisms, compatible with restriction: $\iota_W(c)|_{W'}=\iota_{W'}(c)$ for every morphism $W'\to W$ of $T_{\Et}$). Then every section of $\Lambda_T$ is locally constant: for every object $W$ of $T_{\Et}$ and every $\lambda\in\Lambda_T(W)$ there are a covering $\{W_l\to W\}_{l\in L}$ of $W$ in $T_{\Et}$ (a jointly surjective family of etale morphisms) and elements $c_l\in\Lambda$ with $\lambda|_{W_l}=\iota_{W_l}(c_l)$ for all $l\in L$.

source.place: Sites, Lemma 00WK (lemma-sections-sheafification): every section of the sheafification of a presheaf of sets is locally the image of a section of the presheaf; Sites, Section 00YR (section-sheaves-algebraic-structures) items (beta), (gamma): for rings the sheafification is computed on the underlying presheaf of sets, so the same holds for the constant sheaf of rings

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line, plus one lemma for the covering form (as on lem-weil-pbc-abelian-sheaf-epi-locally-surjective): take J = T.smallEtaleTopology, A = CommRingCat.{u} (Λ in universe u, or ULift Λ), P = (Functor.const _).obj (CommRingCat.of Λ), so that (constantSheaf J _).obj Λ = (presheafToSheaf J _).obj P (ConstantSheaf.lean:66) and ι = toSheafify J P (Sheafification.lean:102); the instance at LocallyBijective.lean:136 gives Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J ι, i.e. (LocallySurjective.lean:94) the image sieve of every λ ∈ Λ_T(W) is J-covering; its instance arguments are AffineEtale.lean:124 (WEqualsLocallyBijective) and :112 (HasSheafify), whose hypotheses on A (forget preserves limits and filtered colimits, reflects isomorphisms, HasLimits, HasColimits) hold for CommRingCat. By smallGrothendieckTopology_eq_toGrothendieck_smallPretopology and mem_toGrothendieck_smallPretopology (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/Small.lean:203, 234) a sieve of the small etale site is covering iff it contains a jointly surjective family of etale arrows, which is the node's form.
